title: AI-driven tongue image analysis for diagnosing and predicting coronary artery disease.
summary: Machine-learning analysis of tongue images from 906 angiography patients predicted coronary-artery disease and related image-derived features to measured stenosis.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis of tongue images predicts coronary-artery disease and relates image features to measured stenosis.
organization: Department of Traditional Medicine, School of Persian Medicine, Tehran University of Medical Sciences, Tehran, Iran

evidence.tested: Machine-learning analysis of tongue images from 906 angiography patients predicted coronary-artery disease and related image-derived features to measured stenosis.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
